lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play), while Cleveland Browns owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#7 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Cleveland Browns +3.3 with a fair total of 41.6 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cleveland Browns run offence vs Baltimore Ravens run defence, which sits −0.146 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Baltimore Ravens and Cleveland Browns have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
